title: Marriott Residences Aida Oman | Branded Apartments Muscat
text: MARRIOTT RESIDENCES AIDA, OMAN. AIDA | OMAN. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a branded residential complex at AIDA, Muscat, developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC using the Marriott name under license. The development offers fully furnished one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments from 60 to 194 sqm, with a la carte services including concierge, reception, doorman, lobby, and valet. Located 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. Disclaimer: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed or sold by Marriott International, Inc. or its affiliates. Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC uses the Marriott marks under a license from Marriott, which has not confirmed the accuracy of any of the statements or representations made herein. PROPERTY TYPE: Branded Residential Complex. STATUS: Under Development. AREA (SQM): 60 - 194. UNIT TYPE: 1, 2, 3 Bedrooms. Seamless integration of stylish, comfortable, and contemporary decor ensures a harmonious flow throughout the meticulously furnished apartments. KEY FEATURES: owners experience home comforts and Marriott's services: concierge, reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. Nearby: Nikki Beach (2024); Al Bustan Palace, Ritz-Carlton Muscat; Shangri-La; Jumeirah Muscat Bay Hotel; Muscat International Airport. AMENITIES: Championship Golf Course; Plazas, Cafes & Restaurants; Wellness Centers; Fitness Center; Promenades; Hiking Trails; Mountain Bike Trails; Luxury Hotels; Outdoor Landscapes; Running Trail; Viewing Decks; Private Beach Enclave; Parks; Swimming Pools; Children's Splash Areas; Club House. LOCATION: Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination. FAQ: When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed? Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Who developed it? Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. What services? A la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet.
